# Test Module

A QML module with a layout type and a page.


The module documents QML dot-path links from a QML type body and from a plain page. See the [Layout](qml-othermodule-layout.md) type page for the links.


| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [Layout](qml-testmodule-layout.md) | A QML type that fills the remaining vertical space. |
| [Panel](qml-testmodule-panel.md) | A QML type documented from a QML source file. |
